text: Binary measure on the OP's "argument" text only (current supplied text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly admits uncertainty, doubt, or possible error about their own view or claims (e.g. "I'm not sure", "I could be wrong", "I may be mistaken"); 0 if the argument is present but has no such explicit admission. Ignore quoted others' text or opponents' positions unless the OP adopts them as their own. Exclude, and don't use as evidence, any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and stays eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Null if the argument is missing or malformed.
